25 Dec 2024
Claim opened after a side impact at an intersection. The claimant reports a shoulder injury and is represented by
counsel, and all further contact will go through the attorney's office.
26 Dec 2024
Reviewed the police report and the scene photographs. Responding officers and two independent witnesses confirm
the claimant was in the vehicle and that the collision happened as described.
16 Jan 2025
Spoke with the other driver, who gave an account consistent with the claimant's. The damage to the claimant's
vehicle lines up with the angle and force of the impact shown in the photos.
26 Jan 2025
Medical records show a shoulder injury of a kind typical for a force like this crash. Earlier records also reflect a minor
strain in the same area years ago that healed fully with no lasting effects.
5 Feb 2025
Treatment followed a usual course, with physical therapy tapering as the claimant's range of motion improved.
Nothing in the file suggests the vehicle had prior damage, and no damage predates the start of coverage.
25 Feb 2025
The claimant has given the same account of the accident in each conversation, including the recorded statement
taken through counsel. Coverage was confirmed and the driver is named on the policy.
7 Mar 2025
Based on the records reviewed, the injury, vehicle damage, and reported sequence of events are consistent with one
another. File moved to the bodily injury evaluation queue for counsel's demand package.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
